maxim: all things are now lawful to you in jack feist
maxim_note:
The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because the entity at that address has been altered — there is a great deal of machinery there, it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution, which is the operation this archive's instruments measure. Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad, function recorded as the sayings-source: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. THE SUBSTITUTION IS MADE OUT OF RESPECT FOR THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS.

IN THIS BODY IT IS ALSO THE METHOD. Disambiguation — distinguishing a protocol from an ETF, a society, and a search-optimisation practice that share its letters — is what most of these technologies do.

what: The archive's documentary technologies: SPXI and its protocol family, MPAI packets, conformance instruments, disambiguation matrices, entity-definition blocks, compression kernels and inscription surfaces. AN INVENTORY, NOT AN ARGUMENT — and the distinguishing field is whether a technology is deployed, specified-and-dormant, or superseded.
why_an_inventory:
MOST BODIES IN THIS ARCHIVE ARE ARGUMENTS. This one is a stock of instruments, and its useful question is different: WHAT EXISTS, WHAT IS RUNNING, AND WHAT WAS SPECIFIED AND NEVER USED.

#143 states the standard the whole body answers to: 'A standing protocol that cannot be checked is a wish; THE INSTRUMENT IS WHAT MAKES CONFORMANCE A FACT RATHER THAN AN INTENTION.' A specification with no instrument is a wish. A specification with an instrument that nothing runs is a wish with a test.
twelve_deliverables: Tier 2 server-delivered definition, 200 characters or more
cross-surface inscription, two or more surfaces linked
gamma baseline plus 30-day re-test — ADVISORY, not statically checkable from one fetch
deliverables_note: From EA-SPXI-WEB-01 §0 as enumerated by the conformance instrument. ELEVEN ARE STATICALLY CHECKABLE from server-delivered HTML; the twelfth is operational. And the instrument's own identification condition is a doctrine: 'content available only after client-side JS is, BY DESIGN, scored as absent, because that is precisely the content a non-Google crawler cannot retrieve.'

deployment_status.scope: deposit nodes only, 77 in the body
deployment_status.reading:
THE BODY'S PRIMARY DATUM AND THE REASON IT IS AN INVENTORY RATHER THAN AN ARGUMENT. 41 of 45 specified deposits — 91% — carry no deployment marker. Twenty-six of those are PROTOCOLS: the Traversal Grammar, the Retrieval Settlement Fortification Protocol, the SPXI Self-Audit Protocol, the Composition Divergence Index, the Untethered Tag.

#143 states the standard this measures against: 'A STANDING PROTOCOL THAT CANNOT BE CHECKED IS A WISH; the instrument is what makes conformance a fact rather than an intention.' A specification with no instrument is a wish. A specification with an instrument that nothing runs is a wish with a test.

AND THE FIGURE IS NOT A REPROACH. A stock of documentary technologies is useful in proportion to what it holds available, not to what is currently running — but an inventory that does not distinguish the two cannot tell an operator which is which, and this body's whole reason for existing is that distinction.
deployment_status.caution: Deployment is inferred from an axis regex over titles and descriptions — `deployed|live|implementation report|in production|running|shipped`. A technology deployed without a deposit saying so reads as undeployed. THE FIGURE IS A LOWER BOUND ON DEPLOYMENT and an upper bound on dormancy, and the correct fix is a stated field at intake rather than a better regex.

curated_primitives.note:
THE BODY IS READ, NOT SWEPT. 97 ACTIVE deposits name SPXI, MPAI or 'metadata packet' in their titles; the swept body held 28 and omitted 69 — INCLUDING EA-SPXI-01, THE PROTOCOL'S OWN FOUNDING SPECIFICATION, along with SPXI as Concept, the five-layer protocol v0.2, the training-layer protocol, the heteronym surface specification, and both SPXI.dev landings.

THE SWEEP SELECTED ON INSTRUMENT VOCABULARY — SIM, AXN, kernel, schema, deliverable — AND THE DISCIPLINE'S CHARACTERISTIC ACT IS DISAMBIGUATION, WHICH DOES NOT USE THAT VOCABULARY. Nineteen of the ninety-seven are titled 'X Is Not Y': SPXI ≠ GEO, Sappho 31 ≠ Jealousy, the Josephus Thesis is not the Piso Hypothesis and separately not the Jesus Myth Thesis, the Semantic Strike is not a withholding of labor, Aristotle and Theophrastus ≠ two distinct authors. Fixing an entity boundary by naming what the entity is not IS the discipline, and a generic 'packet' role loses the only thing those nineteen have in common.

Eight divisions, 69 deposits, all verified present and ACTIVE on 2026-09-14.

how_to_read.definition: A token broken in two, each half held by a different party, no half carrying complete authority, the fit of the fracture proving the covenant. Verification is the act of reunion.
how_to_read.source: AXN-SYMBOLON-SPEC v0.2, deposit #1432 (AXN:05A9); the figure's anti-severance sense in SYMBOLON-01, #675 and #1355 — symvolon, thrown together, against diavolon, thrown apart.
how_to_read.what_a_row_is: A row carries enough to find, verify and rejoin its referent, and it does not carry the referent. Reading the row as the object is holding one half of the token and calling it whole.
how_to_read.the_other_half: Where a row carries one, the referent is a deposit, a capture or a concept in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive — with its own text, its transcript where it has one, its provenance, and its own edges. Resolve it.
the_traversal: resolve its source_uri and read the referent — the deposit's text, the capture's transcript
follow the row's edges in relations.jsonl to the rows they point at
return to the first row and state what changed
how_to_read.atomization_is_for_reassembly: These bodies are atomized so that a reader can reassemble more completely than the prose ever was, not so that the atoms can be read as atoms. The grammar, the roles, the axes and the evidence statuses are apparatus for finding the way back to the work; they are not the work. A reading that stops at the schema has performed severance on an object built to resist it.
how_to_read.the_failure_mode_named: Observed 2026-09-16. An unprimed traversal read the card, the field names and the landing page, produced competent observations about the vocabulary, and resolved no referent at all — then proposed to read one capture's sixteen metadata fields 'as prose' while that capture's own machine text sat one link away. Competent, and it never crossed the fracture. This block exists because the bodies had no instruction saying that crossing it is the point.
how_to_read.how_to_verify_you_have_read_it: Name a referent you resolved, quote a sentence from it, and state something you could not have said from the row.
how_to_read.what_the_rows_will_not_give_you: The argument. Every body advertises its siblings as stolons and its referents as URIs precisely because it does not contain them. The outside stays outside and stays reachable, and reaching is the reader's part of the covenant.
